![Triangle with angles marked as x, 45 degrees, 50 degrees, and external angle y, showing geometric angle relationships.](assets/002-triangle-with-angles-marked-as-x-45-degrees-50-d.png)

In the diagram, *ABC* is a straight line and *BDC* is a triangle.

Find the value of $x$ and the value of $y$.
parts.solution_md:
> *Recognise that angles in a triangle add up to 180°*

$50+45+x=180\,x=180-50-45$

$x=85$

**[B1]**

> *Recognise that angles on a straight line also add up to 180°*

$50+y=180\,y=180-50$

$y=130$

**[B1]**

The diagram shows triangle $PRS$ and a straight line $QS$. 
$Q$ is a point on $PR$. 
Angle $QRS$ = 25°, angle $RSQ$ = 32° and $PS=QS$.

i) Find angle $PQS.$

Angle $PQS$ = ................................................... [2]

ii)Find angle $PSR$.

Angle $PSR$ = ................................................... [2]
parts.solution_md:
i)*Angles in a triangle sum to 180°, work out angle RQS. .*

$180-32-25=123^{\circ}$

**[1]**

> *Angles on a straight line sum to 180°, work out angle PQS.  *

$180-123=57^{\circ}$

**57° ****[1]**

ii)*Triangle PQS is isosceles so angle QPS is also 57° because base angles in an isosceles triangle are equal.*
*Work out angle PSQ by subtracting these from 180°.  *

$180-57-57=66^{\circ}$

**[1]**

> *To find angle PSR, add on 32°.  *

$66+32=98$

**98°**** ****[1]**

equations.alt: P S space equals space Q S
180 space minus space 32 space minus space 25 space equals space 123 degree
180 space minus space 123 space equals space 57 degree
180 space minus space 57 space minus space 57 space equals space 66 degree
66 space plus thin space 32 space equals space 98

parts.problem_md:
The diagram shows a trapezium.

![qp14-0580-11-paper-1-may-2020-cie-igcse-maths](assets/005-qp14-0580-11-paper-1-may-2020-cie-igcse-maths.png)

Work out the value of $x$.

$x$ = ..................................................
parts.solution_md:
> *Because of the two parallel lines, the two angles given are **co-interior **(or **allied**).*

> *Add the angles together and set equal to *$180^{\circ}$* (co-interior angles add up to *$180^{\circ}$*). *

$97-3x+69+5x=180$

**[1]**

> *Rewrite the equation so that all of the *$x$* terms are together and then combine like terms. *

$\begin{gathered} - 3 x + 5 x + 97 + 69 & = 180 \\ \\ 2 x + 166 & = 180 \end{gathered}$

**[1]**

> *Solve the equation by subtracting 166 from both sides, then divide both sides by 2. *

$\begin{array}{rcl} 2 x & = 180 - 166 \\ \\ 2 x & = 14 \\ \\ x = 14 \div 2 \\ \\ x = 7 \end{array}$

> * *

$x=7$* ***[1]**

equations.alt: 97 minus 3 x plus 69 plus 5 x equals 180
bold italic x bold equals bold 7
